name: TOB AI Provider
description: Platform config, not per-user data — one row per AI vendor integration (deepseek, openai, mock, ...). System-Manager-only; api_key is never returned by any REST response (Password fieldtype). Mirrors qtt_platform's QTT AI Provider shape structurally — same trust boundary, same pattern, zero code dependency.

fields.label: Provider Key
fields.description: Matches the Python provider class's own provider_key/name constant, e.g. 'deepseek', 'openai', 'mock'.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Toggling this off routes around a misbehaving provider without a deploy.

fields.label: Is Fallback Provider
fields.description: At most one provider may be flagged — enforced in validate().

fields.label: Base URL
fields.description: Optional override — each provider class has its own sensible default.

fields.label: API Key
fields.description: Server-side only. Read via frappe.utils.password.get_decrypted_password() from provider code — never exposed through any whitelisted method's return value.
